meta.source: Totem — manually curated from official event pages

events.name: Walsh Talks: Future of PBSA
events.desc: Discussions on PBSA innovation and sustainability — construction form, Passivhaus standards, and performance-led design. Evening event followed by industry networking.

events.name: London PropTech Show 2026
events.desc: Smart buildings, IoT, energy management and ESG compliance in real estate. Focus on net-zero tools, digital twins, and smart energy management systems.

events.name: edie 26 — Sustainable Business
events.desc: UK's longest-running sustainable business event. Energy & buildings track, climate resilience, circularity, innovation. 1,000+ sustainability leaders across sectors.

events.name: WinPBSA Annual Summit 2026
events.desc: Women in PBSA Summit — two days of collaboration, leadership and action for senior executives from across the residential living sector. Hosted at Nobu Hotel, Marrakesh. Limited capacity.

events.name: CIBSE Decarbonisation Conference 2026
events.desc: 150+ built environment professionals. Sessions on low carbon heating, whole building retrofit, performance frameworks, and the policy and finance needed to decarbonise the built environment.

events.name: Student Housing Conference 2026
events.desc: The leading annual UK & European student housing conference. 500+ delegates. Key sessions on technology & innovation in PBSA, smart building management, AI-driven operations, and the Renters' Rights Act.

events.name: Decarbonising Heating & Cooling 2026
events.desc: Dedicated two-day conference on heat networks, heat pumps, and low-carbon heating. System design, resilience, performance monitoring, and real-world implementation across commercial buildings.

events.name: GSL Investor Summit Europe 2026
events.desc: Invitation-only summit for leading global residential living investors, funders, developers and operators across Europe. Chatham House roundtables on PBSA, BTR and co-living, with sessions on energy management, AI-driven operations, and European market dynamics.

events.name: Student Living UK 2026
events.desc: Exclusive forum for HE and housing sector leaders. Site tours, workshops, and thought leadership on affordability, supply, student experience, and sustainability. Built on the UK National Action Framework with 47 stakeholder organisations.

events.name: StuRents Annual Summit 2026
events.desc: Return of the StuRents Annual Summit. Hundreds of sector leaders. Thought leadership and proprietary data on occupancy, rental trends, and market dynamics across UK student accommodation.

events.name: CIBSE Technology and Innovation Conference 2026
events.loc: CIBSE HQ, Saffron Hill, London EC1N
events.desc: One-day conference for building services engineers on AI, digital engineering, and intelligent building systems. Sessions cover AI-driven building operations and predictive maintenance, decarbonisation through technology, and the future skills agenda — directly relevant to Totem's positioning in smart PBSA energy management.

events.name: edie Green Buildings Forum & Workshops 2026
events.desc: Invite-only day focused on decarbonising building stock, forming part of London Climate Action Week. 100+ hand-picked sustainability, energy and green buildings professionals. Keynotes, expert panels, hands-on workshops.

events.name: CIBSE UK Net Zero Carbon Buildings Standard Conference 2026
events.desc: Practice-focused conference on implementing the UK Net Zero Carbon Buildings Standard, launched March 2026. Early adopter case studies, sector-specific delineation requirements, and how organisations can align portfolios and strategies with the UK's first cross-industry net-zero buildings definition.

events.name: PropTech Connect Europe 2026
events.desc: Europe's largest PropTech event. 6,000+ attendees, 400 speakers, 2,500 companies across 85 countries. Features a dedicated Smart Building Showcase. Strong ESG, sustainability, and energy management track.

events.name: Living UK Conference 2026
events.desc: The UK's largest Living sectors conference, with around 600 delegates across Build to Rent, Co-Living, Student Housing, Single Family, Retirement Living and Affordable Housing. Dedicated student housing stream plus cross-sector panels on investment and operations, and 50+ speakers including Watkin Jones, Greystar, Student Roost, Fusion and Host. Welcome drinks on 21 September, full conference day on 22 September.

events.name: UK Living Series: Student Housing Summit 2026
events.desc: Bisnow's half-day summit on the UK student housing market, covering development pipeline, investment appetite and operational performance. Afternoon format with heavy networking. A useful room for Totem: operators and asset managers who own the energy bill.

events.name: Smart Buildings Show 2026
events.desc: The UK's only dedicated commercial smart buildings conference and exhibition. 3,500 visitors, 100 exhibitors. Four theatres: Energy Management, Controls & Networks, IT & Digital Infrastructure, and Management & PropTech. Free to attend.

events.name: GSL Investor Summit — London
events.desc: By-invitation-only event for top PBSA investors, developers and operators. Exclusive market insights and high-value networking. Takes place alongside GSL Live 2026 in London.

events.name: GSL Live 2026
events.desc: Annual sector gathering for everyone in PBSA — universities, operators, service providers. Insight stream covering trends, research and resident data, plus a collaboration stream. GSL Awards ceremony follows.

events.name: Property Week Tech Innovation Forum & Awards 2026
events.desc: A daytime forum on how technology and data are changing UK real estate, followed by the Tech Innovation Awards. Sessions cover proptech, sustainability, operations and occupier experience. Small and focused rather than a trade show, and the judging panel is drawn from the operators and consultants Totem sells into.

events.name: FT Energy Transition Summit 2026
events.desc: Global leaders from energy, finance, industry and government on the energy transition. Electrification, digitalisation, energy security and affordability.

events.name: The Class Conference 2026
events.desc: Europe's largest student housing conference, convening a community of 90+ industry players from real estate, higher education, urban planning and policy. Two days of keynotes, breakouts, site tours and the Best in Class Awards dinner, exploring investment, social impact, public-private agendas and tomorrow's student experience — a key stage for Totem's smart PBSA energy-management story.

events.name: Property Week ESG Edge 2026
events.desc: Sustainability, social value and governance strategies across the property industry. Strong crossover with energy and EPC positioning — PBSA operators with ESG mandates are core attendees.

events.name: CIBSE Build2Perform Live 2026
events.desc: CIBSE's building performance conference, now incorporated into elementalLONDON and co-located with London Build at ExCeL. Two days of CPD-accredited content on building services, metering and net-zero operation. Same dates and venue as the elementalLONDON entry below — one ticket covers all three shows.

events.name: elementalLONDON 2026 (with London Build)
events.desc: The UK's largest show for construction, building services and sustainability, drawing 25,000+ built environment professionals, 650+ exhibitors and 900+ speakers across 15 stages. Newly moved to ExCeL, co-located with London Build and incorporating CIBSE Build2Perform. Large-scale residential efficiency is one of three headline pillars — the closest thing to a home venue for Totem's proposition.

events.name: Property Week Student Accommodation Conference & Awards 2026
events.desc: The UK's leading student accommodation event, now in its 19th year: around 1,300 attendees, 50+ speakers and 45 partners across a one-day conference and evening awards. Sustainability and operational cost sit on the main agenda, making it the single best PBSA room for Totem all year.

events.name: MIPIM 2027
events.desc: The global real estate market's set-piece week, with 25,000+ participants and around 6,000 investors. Expensive and broad rather than targeted, but every major PBSA investor and pan-European operator is there, and the Living and ESG programmes have grown steadily.

events.name: edie 27
events.desc: edie's flagship two-day sustainable business event, returning to the Business Design Centre. Audience is corporate sustainability and energy leads rather than property specifically, which makes it better for market intelligence and partner conversations than for direct PBSA lead generation.

events.name: Futurebuild 2027
events.desc: Three days on sustainable construction and the built environment, co-located with UK Construction Week. CPD programme spans net-zero pathways, retrofit at scale and digital performance tools. Relevant to Totem as a retrofit measure, though the audience skews to new build and materials.
